A body at the left of a circular path retains an inward net-force arrow to the right and a downward tangent-velocity arrow. The force keeps a closed triangular head while velocity keeps an open head; line thickness is standardised at 1.4 mm, so the head shape and external key distinguish the noncommensurate quantities. Ten source dashes remain: the lower-left dash nearest the tangent is omitted to widen its legibility gap. Body and centre markers are enlarged relative to the path.
